title: Top Words
summary: Return the n most frequent words in text, most frequent first; ties are broken alphabetically. Words are runs of ASCII letters and digits, compared case-insensitively (as in word-count).
hints: Count the words first (you did this in word-count), then work on the (word, count) pairs.
Sort by count descending, then by word ascending: one comparator that checks both keys.
Take the first n and keep only the words. Try writing it as a chain: entries -> sort -> take -> map.
